title: Implant from a VA surgeon moving under the microscope
place_text: Department of Veterans Affairs, United States

tellings.quote: according to the pathologist it was moving under the microscope under its own metabolism wow yeah and it was removed by a surgeon from the Department of Veterans Affairs from a US veteran who claimed to have a up close and personal contact with the UAP

plain: An object implanted in a US veteran's body, removed by a surgeon from the Department of Veterans Affairs, moved under the microscope, the pathologist said, "under its own metabolism." Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, tells Michels this from his own involvement. He says the veteran claimed close personal contact with a UAP, the government's term for an unexplained flying object, and if the story is right the implant would be something alive or working on its own.
